mentions.name: Stremio Real-Debrid streaming plugin
mentions.description: A plugin for Stremio that streams the author's personal media collection from Real-Debrid.
mentions.problem: Existing Stremio plugins for streaming from Real-Debrid were not working for the author.
mentions.audience: Nothing fancy and not particularly useful to others, but very useful to the author personally and their wife.
mentions.source_excerpt: I (codex) made a plugin for stremio to stream my collection from real-debrid.
